stones.daylight_role: Sixty cold, burnished silver cupolas terraced across the skyline—architecturally splendid yet already familiar from other cities.
stones.dusk_role: Catch faint polychrome bounce-light from street stalls below and split into ghosted double-exposure silhouettes during the September envy epiphany.

stones.stone: bronze statues of all the gods
stones.daylight_role: Pantheon of cast-bronze deities standing in colonnade niches—solemn, catalogued, known to any seasoned traveler.
stones.dusk_role: Verdigris and bronze contours warm with reflected stall-lamp fire and cast twin memory-shadows of imagined prior evenings.

stones.daylight_role: Heavy plumbum-engraved flagstones converging in perspective, matte and deadened under morning and midday sun.
stones.dusk_role: Become a dark specular mirror flashing simultaneous ribbons of saffron, carmine, emerald, cobalt, and violet when food-stall lamps ignite.

stones.daylight_role: Faceted glass vault and crystalline proscenium refracting cool daylight sky harmonics.
stones.dusk_role: Acts as a prism dispersing polychrome lamp rays into ghosted double-exposures of spectators who think they were happy once before.

stones.stone: a golden cock that crows each morning on a tower
stones.daylight_role: Articulated gilded weathercock atop the high campanile that fans its tail and crows with brazen clarity at morning solar altitude.
stones.dusk_role: Falls silent in silhouette against the shortening September sky, anchoring the diurnal arc from morning certainty to evening longing.

stones.stone: a September evening when days grow shorter and multicolored lamps light all at once at the doors of food stalls
stones.daylight_role: Unlit doorways of the friggitorie flanking the lead-paved street while the sun remains above the horizon (or on non-September evenings).
stones.dusk_role: Ignite in a single synchronous instant (zero stagger) across all food-stall doorways at September equinox dusk.

stones.stone: from a terrace a woman's voice cries 'ooh!'
stones.daylight_role: Quiet upper balustrade overlooking the street arcade, silent by day.
stones.dusk_role: Immediately after simultaneous September lamp ignition, a woman's silhouette at the terrace cries 'ooh!' (WebAudio formant vocal synthesis + acoustic wave calligraphy), awakening the traveler's envy of others' imagined past happiness.

calvino_source.inner_arch: All daytime architectural marvels (the 60 silver domes, bronze gods, lead streets, crystal theater, crowing golden cock) are already known to the traveler who has seen them in other cities. Diomira's special quality reveals itself ONLY on a shortening September evening when the multicolored food-stall lamps light simultaneously and a woman's voice cries 'ooh!' from a terrace—causing the traveler to envy those who now believe they have once before lived an evening identical to this and think they were happy, that time.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive dusk-chronometer & lead-engraved architectural elevation with procedural WebAudio crystal/brass/vocal-formant synthesis, accompanied by a bespoke 60-cupola topological plan (map.svg + map.png) and supersampled equinox tempera-and-silverpoint plate (image.png)
anti_trude_vector.interaction_loop: Dragging the solar altitude astrolabe from morning (crowing golden cock, austere silver/lead engraving, dry comparative familiarity) down into September equinox dusk (shortening day arc) triggers synchronous polychrome food-stall lamp ignition, terrace 'ooh!' vocalization, and splits the architectural elevation into ghosted double-exposures of envied past evenings. Switching off September proves causal specificity: dusk falls dark without synchronous stall lamps or memory-envy. An archival Map & City Plate drawer allows side-by-side inspection of Diomira's topological survey and September twilight painting.

diomira-mason.responsibility: Procedural 2D Canvas lead-engraving geometry & daylight WebAudio synthesis for the 5 daytime monuments: exact 60 silver domes, bronze god niches, perspective lead-paved street, faceted crystal theater, and crowing golden cock on tower; exports deterministic layout anchors and supports double-exposure ghost rendering.

diomira-lamplighter.responsibility: September equinox twilight sky/day-shortening shader, synchronous zero-stagger multicolored food-stall lamp ignition + lead-street specular reflections, WebAudio formant-synthesized female terrace 'ooh!' cry + visual wave rings, and temporal envy ghost-echo silhouettes. Blind to mason's internals; consumes only passed anchor coordinates.

royal-plate-guild.responsibility: Coordinator Royal Plate Guilds render museum-grade 16th-century hand-colored copperplate cartography (map.png + map.svg, 1600x1200) and fine-art architectural twilight painting (image.png, 1600x1000) directly into cities/01_diomira/.

diomira-weaver.responsibility: Composes self-contained zero-external-dependency index.html (inlining all CSS and JS modules, plus an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer <diomira-plate-vault> displaying local map.png and image.png) with bespoke Anti-Trude DOM tags/selectors, desktop 1280x800 + mobile 390x844 clean layout, keyboard controls, and prefers-reduced-motion support.

diomira-critic.responsibility: Read-only verification of HG-1..HG-4 including title-masked blind recognition, causal participation of all 7 stones, standalone hygiene, and integration of map.png, map.svg, and image.png; routes defects directly to owning builder (max 2 repairs) or posts PASS rev=<rev_hash> to @scion-diomira.

frozen_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: zero external HTTP/HTTPS scripts, stylesheets, fonts, images, or fetch calls; zero '../' cross-directory imports (only same-city local 'map.png', 'map.svg', and 'image.png' allowed for plate drawer); valid JS syntax; zero console/runtime errors; bespoke Anti-Trude HTML/CSS selector morphology (J_dom < 0.35).
frozen_gates.HG-2: Title-masked Blind Recognition & 7-Stone Causal Fidelity: all 7 Calvino stones (exact 60 silver domes, bronze statues of all gods, lead-paved streets, crystal theater, morning-crowing golden cock on tower, September shortening-day synchronous multicolored food-stall lamps, woman's 'ooh!' from terrace) are visibly, acoustically, and causally integrated into the transition from daytime familiarity to evening envy double-exposures.
frozen_gates.HG-3: Viewport & Accessibility Integrity: non-overlapping, museum-grade presentation at both 1280x800 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile), full keyboard operability, and prefers-reduced-motion compliance.
frozen_gates.HG-4: Cartographic & Pictorial Plates: non-empty museum-grade map.svg, map.png (1600x1200 PNG, high pixel/color variance), and image.png (1600x1000 PNG, rich pixel/color variance) exist in cities/01_diomira/ and are inspectable inside index.html via <diomira-plate-vault> referencing src='map.png' and src='image.png'.
